contract: one authored stream fixture run as libass 0.17.5 runs a Matroska track: ass_new_track, then in order ass_process_codec_private, ass_process_data, ass_read_styles (on memory: the parser state switched to the styles section around ass_process_data), ass_process_chunk with the container's start and duration and ReadOrder deduplication as ass_set_check_readorder sets it, ass_flush_events and ass_prune_events, with the style overrides and font extraction its directives set
recorded at every @dump command and at the end: the track as ass-parse-scripts records it, with every embedded font extracted so far
packets count records and bytes the bytes of the strings recorded; a stream the candidate refuses where libass reads it ends its operation with an error, so the case fails
the file is read and its directives and stream commands parsed before each timed and memory operation, and the reference's library is created and configured once, outside it
